components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with gradient and icon circle.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #005C8A 0%, #007BB8 100%); color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -4px rgba(0, 92, 138, 0.5), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -4px rgba(0, 92, 138, 0.7), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); } .ds-btn-icon-circle { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary frosted pill button with cyan hover border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #F5F5F5; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(0, 178, 227, 0.4); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }

components.name: Double-Bezel Card
components.description: Two-layer hardware container with frosted glass and top specular rim.
components.html:
Universal KHQR

Outputs standard EMVCo compliant KHQR payload strings and instant mobile deeplinks.
components.css: .ds-bezel-card { border-radius: 24px; padding: 1.5px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 100%); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bezel-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 54, 90, 0.35); } .ds-bezel-card-inner { border-radius: 22.5px; background: rgba(10, 18, 30, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .ds-card-title { color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-body { color: #9CA3AF; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The design system projects security, cryptographic rigor, and frictionless speed. Built for Cambodian developers navigating real financial transactions, the interface pairs deep dark navy canvases with glowing Cambodian Royal Blue and vibrant Cyan highlights.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian backdrop (#040911) paired with frosted midnight panels (#0A121E)
Royal Blue (#005C8A) and PayWay Cyan (#00B2E3) brand accents
Double-bezel hardware styling with subtle light borders
Tabular numbers and monospaced code blocks for financial accuracy

rules.name: The Trust Anchor Rule
rules.body: Royal Blue and Cyan are reserved strictly for interactive affordances, brand anchors, and verified statuses.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: All monetary amounts, transaction IDs, and numeric metrics must render with .tabular-nums or monospace fonts.

rules.name: The Double-Bezel Rule
rules.body: Significant containers use a two-layer structure: an outer gradient border shell enclosing an inner frosted dark surface.

dos: Do wrap primary interactive modules in the double-bezel card structure (.bezel-card).
Do use font-mono and .tabular-nums for all transaction IDs, monetary figures, and hashes.
Do include focus rings with #00B2E3 outline on all interactive inputs and buttons.
Do respect user preferences with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
donts: Don't use generic stark gray cards with flat solid borders.
Don't mix unstyled raw numbers into financial tables or QR codes.
Don't introduce competing accent colors outside established status tags.
Don't create sharp 90-degree square buttons; preserve pill and rounded geometry.
